verdict.rationale: Clipboard history is a fair question for a desktop operating system, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions clipboard history, text or image clipboard entries, or a hotkey to open one. The only related item is a bare 'Keyboard shortcuts in Windows' page title, which does not show that this capability exists.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can access a unified clipboard history across text and images with one hotkey
